subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II evidence intake & audit window clarification
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II evidence intake & audit window clarification

Hi Samir —

Thanks for agreeing to take our intake. To move this along as quickly as possible, two quick asks from our side:

1) Confirm what you need from us as a minimum (report + bridge letter vs. a larger artifact set). Our current preferred delivery is a Type II report covering our audit period: 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31. If your report does not cover that window, a signed bridge letter that maps controls to the requested period is acceptable.

2) If you do want artifacts, below is a minimal set that speeds review without sending full raw datasets: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) + Auditor’s opinion page
- Bridge letter (if applicable)
- Evidence matrix (see attached template) mapping controls to artifacts
- Policy snapshots (Security, Change Management, Access Management) with version/date
- Sample access log extracts (one-week window around key dates) or summary queries (not full raw logs)
- Change control records for 2 representative releases during the audit period
- Key management/config snapshots (KMS config, rotation cadence)

Secure transfer options we support: S3 presigned (short TTL), ShareFile, or a Drive folder with restricted share. We’ve attached an \"s3-presigned-instructions.pdf\" stub and an evidence matrix template to speed the mapping. If you prefer a short DocuSign bridge letter flow, we can provide a template.

Below are two short reply templates you can use if you’re delegating:
- Delegation: “Hi — forwarding to our security team to pull the SOC 2 package. Expect a response by EOD +3.”
- Quick accept: “We can share the Type II report and a bridge letter. Please send the share method.”

I’ve attached: evidence_matrix_template.xlsx, s3-presigned-instructions.pdf. Also attached is a sample bridge letter we can send back if that helps accelerate procurement.

Would you prefer we upload directly to a Drive folder or send presigned links? Happy to hop on a 20-min call this week if helpful — available Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0123

Thanks Neha — this is great, appreciate the matrix. Quick clarifying question: for \"sample access log extracts\" do you need raw logs (we typically redacted PII) or are summarized queries/CSV extracts sufficient? Our security team prefers not to hand over full raw logs for vendor reviews.

We can provide:
- Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter if our audit window doesn't fully align
- Policy snapshots
- 3-day log extracts centered on two high-risk dates (redacted)

We can upload to a secure Drive link or send S3 presigned. Would prefer to get the exact share path you want. Also looping in Laura who owns vendor intake on our side.

—Samir

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Laura. Short answers below: 

- Logs: summarized extracts or CSV query outputs are fine for initial intake (e.g., columns: timestamp, user_id_hash, action, resource). Redact any PII (user emails, full IPs) — a 3-day extract around two representative dates is exactly what we need. If you can only provide aggregated queries, include the query and sample output so our auditors can validate.

- Delivery: S3 presigned links are preferred (we can provide an IAM role for presigned PUTs if that’s easier). Drive/ShareFile are acceptable if S3 isn’t workable.

- Bridge letter: yes please if your Type II window differs from 2025-06-01 -> 2026-05-31. We’ve attached a bridge_letter_sample.docx and a short set of one-line reply templates (one-line-replies.txt) to make delegation straightforward.

One-line templates (copy/paste):
- \"Delegating to our security team to pull the SOC2 package; expect delivery by [date].\"
- \"We have the Type II report and will provide redacted log extracts via presigned S3 by [date].\"
- \"We will provide a signed bridge letter; please confirm the exact audit window you require.\"

If that works, we can give you a presigned upload target (I’ll send links once you confirm S3 or Drive). If you want a 20-minute alignment call, Tue 2–3pm PT works for me.

Thanks — Neha

Attachments: bridge_letter_sample.docx, one-line-replies.txt

Forwarding Samir’s note + our replies. Quick internal checklist for follow-up:

- Confirm final audit window to share with procurement (Neha to confirm if Acme needs exact 2025-06-01 -> 2026-05-31 or if a bridge letter covers a partial overlap).
- Prepare the evidence_matrix_template.xlsx mapping controls (CC1–CC7) to doc names. I’ll draft the matrix rows for Policy, Change Control, Access logs and drop into the Drive folder.
- Prepare redacted log extracts (3-day windows); Ops to create hash of user IDs, truncate IPs to /24.
- Prepare a finalized bridge_letter_sample.docx to sign (legal ok?). Marissa, can you confirm legal review by EOD Wed?

Marissa / Neha: tagging you for the timeline — if Acme needs the package this week, we should prioritize and provide presigned S3 links.

—Olga
